name: Meal allowance (regular, same rate for all)
authority: LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(9), pp.20–22, read 28 September 2026 item vii and LHDN Public Ruling 5/2019 Perquisites from Employment (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PR_05_2019_2.pdf) para 7.2.3 (p.22, Example 19: RM250 a month exempt): a meal allowance received on a regular basis at the same rate to all employees is exempt from tax, so this class counts toward no PCB base. EPF Act 1991 s.2 “wages” (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) includes any bonus, commission or allowance and excludes any travelling allowance; KWSP employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q8 “Components of Wage”: salary, bonus, allowance, commission, incentives; Q11 “Non-Wages”: travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession; read 28 September 2026 in the browser): an allowance is EPF wages. Act 4 s.2(24) and Act 800 s.2 include any allowance paid in money; a cash meal allowance is not a special expense of the employment: SOCSO, EIS and SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint 2017): basic salary and fixed allowances or other emoluments of a like nature paid in cash, excluding (b) any travelling allowance, (c) special expenses and (e) any bonus or commission: a fixed cash allowance is HRD wages. Employment Act 1955 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint as at 1 August 2023): basic wages and all other payments in cash payable for work done under the contract, excluding (c) any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession: a cash payment, not the in-kind “supply of any food” of exclusion (a), so wages. Owner rule 2026-09-28: the law is silent on a regular meal allowance under Act 4 s.2(24)(c); default — not a special expense (it does not arise from the nature of the work), so wages; lawful because it charges the contribution. An overtime or outstation meal allowance at an internal-circular rate is not this class.

EPF Act 1991 s.2 “wages” (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) includes any bonus, commission or allowance and excludes any travelling allowance; KWSP employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q8 “Components of Wage”: salary, bonus, allowance, commission, incentives; Q11 “Non-Wages”: travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession; read 28 September 2026 in the browser): an allowance is EPF wages. EPF Act 1991 s.2 “wages” (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) includes any bonus, commission or allowance and excludes any travelling allowance; KWSP employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q8 “Components of Wage”: salary, bonus, allowance, commission, incentives; Q11 “Non-Wages”: travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession; read 28 September 2026 in the browser): an allowance is EPF wages. Act 4 s.2(24) and Act 800 s.2 include any allowance paid in money and exclude none of this kind: SOCSO, EIS and SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint 2017): basic salary and fixed allowances or other emoluments of a like nature paid in cash, excluding (b) any travelling allowance, (c) special expenses and (e) any bonus or commission: a fixed cash allowance is HRD wages. Employment Act 1955 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint as at 1 August 2023): basic wages and all other payments in cash payable for work done under the contract, excluding (c) any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession: a cash payment under the contract, so wages. Seeded only in versions from 1 January 2026: the 2026 specification is the source read for the RM3,000; the YA2025 limit is not read.

name: Meal allowance (regular, same rate for all)
authority: LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(9), pp.20–22, read 28 September 2026 item vii and LHDN Public Ruling 5/2019 Perquisites from Employment (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PR_05_2019_2.pdf) para 7.2.3 (p.22, Example 19: RM250 a month exempt): a meal allowance received on a regular basis at the same rate to all employees is exempt from tax, so this class counts toward no PCB base. EPF Act 1991 s.2 “wages” (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) includes any bonus, commission or allowance and excludes any travelling allowance; KWSP employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q8 “Components of Wage”: salary, bonus, allowance, commission, incentives; Q11 “Non-Wages”: travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession; read 28 September 2026 in the browser): an allowance is EPF wages. Act 4 s.2(24) and Act 800 s.2 include any allowance paid in money; a cash meal allowance is not a special expense of the employment: SOCSO, EIS and SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint 2017): basic salary and fixed allowances or other emoluments of a like nature paid in cash, excluding (b) any travelling allowance, (c) special expenses and (e) any bonus or commission: a fixed cash allowance is HRD wages. Employment Act 1955 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint as at 1 August 2023): basic wages and all other payments in cash payable for work done under the contract, excluding (c) any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession: a cash payment, not the in-kind “supply of any food” of exclusion (a), so wages. Owner rule 2026-09-28: the law is silent on a regular meal allowance under Act 4 s.2(24)(c); default — not a special expense (it does not arise from the nature of the work), so wages; lawful because it charges the contribution. An overtime or outstation meal allowance at an internal-circular rate is not this class.

name: Parking allowance

Employment Act 1955 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint as at 1 August 2023): basic wages and all other payments in cash payable for work done under the contract, excluding (c) any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession: a cash payment under the contract, so wages.
